answer: Proof of Personhood protocols resist Sybil attacks by requiring agents to traverse a digital ocean of verified biometric uniqueness. By enforcing a delta between distinct human actors and autonomous clones, the system creates a falcon high-stakes barrier to entry. An attacker must incur the substantial hardware and operational costs of maintaining thousands of unique, non-colluding physical nodes, rendering the mass creation of fake-identity botnets economically unsustainable within the consensus network.
